## Plane crash info example


```{r crashes, resluts='hold'}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")


crash_page


crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()



crash_df=crash_tables[[1]]


# From a cleaning perspective there are several things that can be change
# [1] Replace the colnames with the first row
# [2] Have better column types ( e.g., Date being a date instead of character)
# [3] There are possible things you can to to clean the data within columns: e.g., split column that contain multiple pieces of information
# Column 4 has: fatalities/ # passengers(ground fatalities)


# for todays class, we will focus on the first two


colnames(crash_df)= crash_df[1, ]
#then delete first row
crash_df= crash_df[-1, ]

crash_df=crash_df |>  
  dplyr:: mutate(Date=lubridate::dmy(Date))

head(crash_df)
```



## Game
```{r}
page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")
classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements(".Dreadnought") |>
  rvest::html_text2()
length(classes)

```

```{r}
base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts))
for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |>
      rvest::html_text2(),
    value = pg |> rvest::html_elements("span.salvage-value") |>
      rvest::html_text2() |> readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)

registry |> dplyr::filter(class== "Dreadnought") |>  
  dplyr::mutate(value=as.numeric(value))->Dreadnoughts_df


sum(Dreadnoughts_df$value)
```
## Structured ext extraction 

### Course Info

```{r, courses}
chat= ellmer::chat_openai(
  model  = "gpt-5.6-luna" , # note that the API jey provided only works with 5.6 luna
  params = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
)


isa125_text= rvest::read_html("https://bulletin.miamioh.edu/courses-instruction/isa/") |> 
  rvest::html_elements("#sc_sccoursedescs>div:nth-child(1)") |>  rvest::html_text2()


course_info<- chat$chat_structured(
  isa125_text,
  type= ellmer::type_object(
    name=ellmer::type_string(
      description = "Name of the course. For example, ISA 235. Information Technology and the Intelligent Enterprise"
    ),
    description=ellmer::type_string(description = "The description of the course without the prereqs"),
    prereqs=ellmer::type_string("List the information after prerequisite:")
  )
)
```
